result.title: One Token, Many Lessons: Sliding-Window Attention within Gated Delta Networks
result.summary: Linear attention compresses historical context into a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing the computational and memory costs of long-sequence modeling. From the perspective of test-time regression (TTR), the state matrix can be viewed as an online-learned regression model, where keys and values serve as inputs and targets respectively, and queries are used to read from the model. From this perspective, the effectiveness of state learning depends not only on the update rule but also on how the key-value learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. While existing work has largely focused on how the state is updated and organized, we investigate how the learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. To this end, we propose Sliding-Window Gated DeltaNet (SWGDN), which replaces short convolutions in Delta-Rule linear attention with sliding-window attention to perform content-dependent local aggregation of projected queries, keys, and values. Our experiments show that SWGDN makes the key-value pairs used in consecutive updates more similar in both GDN2 and KDA. In SWGDN, carrying information from the same token across updates can help the recurrent state reinforce a previously learned association. The local mixing strategy can be incorporated into any Delta-Rule-based linear attention architecture without changing its state update equations or chunkwise parallel algorithms. We apply this strategy to two Delta-Rule variants, GDN2 and KDA, and experimental results demonstrate that SWGDN outperforms the original Delta-Rule baseline across multiple benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 该文从 test-time regression 视角重新审视线性注意力的循环状态，指出状态学习效果也取决于用于更新的 key-value 学习对如何构造，并提出 SWGDN：用滑动窗口注意力替换 Delta-Rule 线性注意力中的短卷积，对投影后的 query/key/value 做内容相关的局部聚合，在 GDN2 与 KDA 上验证其使相邻更新的键值对更相似、并提升多基准表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文关注的「状态如何被写入、相邻更新对是否相似、同一 token 信息如何强化既有联想」与 LVR 中 latent 状态的写入与强化、轨迹式状态更新问题可能相关，其不改状态方程与 chunkwise 并行算法的局部混合模块可供核查能否用于多模态 latent 状态的构造；但工作纯属文本语言建模，需判断对视觉证据保留是否有实际收益。
